# No X Health Tracker

A (sloppy) University Project app requested by my old friend for his friends from a different university, made in less than half a month (Starting from: September 18, 2025).

### Personal Note

This application was hand-made, and no AI was used during development.

This application ended up being unfinished as the friend of my old friend from different university
discontinued the project on a whim so all of the effort put into making this app was, essentially, wasted.

While this project was discontinued, this ended up being probably one of my favourite project
to ever worked on. While it's not perfect, but I love how it turned out despite all everything.

### Developer's preface

**Firstly**, this isn't my best effort into making something I would considered 'my best' at all, as I wouldn't even considered myself being average (let alone being proficient) in the both Dart programming language and the Flutter framework in general. Although, I did learned them from a Mobile Programming class at my university.

**Secondly**, I accepted this project purely because I was kind of bored and a little wishes for this project to be some sort of a resume in the future. (I didn't even asked my friend or his friends for any compensation at first, I just accepted it during my walk to home from university)

**Thirdly**, The only app design documentation I've got is a short 30-seconds video recording from an AI mobile app design website (in which I can't even access by myself) and 2 papers (images) on their research and not about the app itself.

**Therefore**, if this application looks like it doesn't have any code documentation or pre-planning at all then, because it is.
